title: I found a tiny train station inside my fridge
script_lines: Behind the milk, something was glowing.
The ticket had my name on it.

subtitle_timings.text: Behind the milk, something was glowing.
The ticket had my name on it.

scene_breakdown.label: Hook
scene_breakdown.summary: a dark kitchen at 3AM, a hand-less fridge door swings open, cold light spills out

scene_breakdown.label: Discovery
scene_breakdown.summary: inside the fridge, behind a glass milk bottle, a warm tiny glow flickers between the shelves

scene_breakdown.label: Reveal
scene_breakdown.summary: a miniature train station built into the fridge shelf, tiny brass lanterns, a small steam train pulling into the platform with no driver and no passengers

scene_breakdown.label: Twist
scene_breakdown.summary: a tiny paper ticket slides out from the train window onto the shelf, engraved destination reads Tomorrow

scene_breakdown.label: Question
scene_breakdown.summary: close-up on the glowing ticket and the waiting train, door light dimming around the edges
